cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags

cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +14.20%, LEU +11.41%, FLNC +9.82%, UUUU +9.79%, UEC +8.87%. Laggards: ENPH -17.02%, VLO -9.55%, DINO -8.81%, MPC -7.75%.
